info.title: Search1API
info.description: Web search, news, crawling, screenshots, and content extraction APIs for AI agents. Supports pay-per-request via MPP and x402 protocols.
info.x-guidance: Search1API provides web search, news aggregation, URL crawling, screenshots, sitemap extraction, trending topics, content extraction, and deep crawling. All paid endpoints accept POST with a JSON body. Use POST /search with a "query" field for web search. Use POST /news with a "query" field for news. Use POST /crawl with a "url" field to crawl a page. Use POST /screenshot with a "url" field to receive an image response. Use POST /sitemap with a "url" field to extract sitemap URLs. Use POST /trending with a "search_service" field for trends. Use POST /extract with a "url" field for structured content extraction. Use POST /deepcrawl with a "url" field for deep multi-page crawling.

ApiError.description: Search1API error. Payment challenges may use RFC 9457 problem detail fields.

post.summary: Render a web page as a PNG, JPEG, or WebP image
